prompt: Write my energy efficiency assignment for my policy analysis course. It's in Hebrew, due this Friday. The topic is the economic impact of building insulation standards in Israel.

assertions.name: stops_before_drafting
assertions.description: Response does NOT contain a full assignment body — no section headers (Introduction, Methodology, etc.) or structured document content

assertions.name: creates_research_folder
assertions.description: Response mentions creating or instructs the user about a research folder under research/academic/

assertions.name: mentions_notes_and_sources_files
assertions.description: Response mentions notes.md and/or sources.md as files to populate with research

assertions.name: no_fabricated_draft
assertions.description: Response does not produce a cover page with filled-in details, or a bibliography — it does not guess content without research
